detail.longDescription: 🐧 SIGINT // Linux Watch — 2026-11-15 Red Heron is going after publicly exposed Gitea servers with a critical vuln and a Linux rootkit for persistence. If your self-hosted git is facing the internet, patch it and check your exposure, because the rootkit won't announce itself. 🔗 https:// b2b-cyber-security.de/en/Linux -rootkit-Red-Heron-exploits-a-critical-GitEA-vulnerability-for-attacks/ # Linux # OpenSource # FOSS
